name: building-placement-cutoff-visual
description: #1391: on seed 42 a living quarters at (1,26) seals the only strip of ground along the west edge (rows 24-28) from the crew. The ghost turns red and the strip's instruction line reads 'Cuts off N bench(es)' while Confirm stays usable. Clicking Confirm opens a 'Place anyway?' modal; Cancel orders nothing and leaves the tool armed; Confirm again then 'Place anyway' performs the placement. Every click is a real player step (BuildMenu catalog, tile picker, ConfirmModal).

steps.description: Staffed opening (#551) so the first building has a roster to build it.

Arm living quarters through the real catalog and pick (1,26): its footprint seals the west-edge strip. Ghost is red and the strip's instruction line carries the cutoff warning (see screenshot), yet Confirm is usable. Nothing ordered yet. Interaction only: the console's build command would order it outright.

expect.note: #1391 -- cutoff leaves Confirm enabled; the warning is a ghost + strip line, not a refusal.

steps.description: Click Confirm: the 'Place anyway?' modal opens instead of ordering. Screenshot the modal, then Cancel: nothing ordered, cash unchanged. Interaction only (console has no modal).

expect.note: #1391 -- cancelling the modal does not place the building.

steps.description: Same still-armed tool: Confirm again, accept 'Place anyway' in the modal. The building is ordered and paid for.

expect.note: #1391 -- accepting the modal performs the placement.
